$comment: Baseline .NET SDK for reproducible builds. rollForward=latestMajor accepts this or any newer installed SDK, so it won't block contributors. Bump 'version' when you intentionally raise the floor, and keep it a full three-part SDK version including the feature band (10.0.100, not 10.0.0) — with rollForward set, actions/setup-dotnet rejects anything shorter, which silently breaks workflows that read this file instead of pinning dotnet-version. The SDK builds every target framework the solution uses; it is not the floor consumers must meet. The shipped libraries multi-target net8.0 and net10.0 so a Godot project on Godot's bundled .NET 8 runtime keeps working — see docs/contributing/design-notes/Target Frameworks.md.
